messages:
elaine: hey team, first week and im stuck on prod observability access. i can open staging Grafana and Datadog but prod returns 403. Sentry shows 'not a member'. followed the onboarding checklist. any quick checks?

tom: welcome @elaine! common causes: Okta group not synced, or the access form had the wrong email domain. quick things: 1) check https://okta.redwood.com/me -> Groups; 2) confirm the access form entry shows Observability -> Prod; 3) try incognito (SSO caching).

amanda: also check mailbox rules for the Sentry invite (some ppl's SSO invites get stuck in filters). if you want i can resend the Sentry org invite.

elaine: i checked Okta and dont see `redwood-observability-prod`. access form shows correct email. tried incognito, still 403.

tom: ok i'll open a devex ticket. please post your manager and team name here. i'll add a note to escalate the group sync.

devex-bot: DEVEX BOT: created ticket DEVEX-9812 for Elaine (observability access). Assigned to amanda and infra-ops.

amanda: got it. @elaine please DM me your manager and i'll trigger the Okta group sync + resend Sentry invite. once youre in the group, Datadog/Grafana should appear within ~10-20m.

elaine: thanks everyone! DM'd manager and called out the ticket. appreciate the fast help :raised_hands:
